main_text.p: Præpofitio tamen hîc frequens eft. Herodot. οἴνῳ ἐκ κριθέων πεποιημένῳ ζυ[?]-χρέονται, vino ex hordeis confecto utuntur. Theophr. Τὰς τριήρεις ἐκ κέδρου ποιῶσι, triremes ex cedro faciunt. Iofeph. εἰσεκόμισε τὴν χρυσῆν σκεύην, λυχνίαν, σπάπεζαν, βωμὸν, ἐκ χρυσοῦ πεποιημένα, importavit & nova vafa, candelabrum, menfam, aram, ex auro facta.
main_text.head: Materiæ dativus.
main_text.p: Dativus hîc etiam aliquando eft. Demofth. ὃ τῷ μὴ καλυφθῆναι ταῦτα σεμνυόμεγ[?], ἀλλὰ τῷ γραφεὶς ἀποφυγεῖν, nō eo glorior quód hæc non prodiderim, neq; eo quód accufationem effugerim. Talis illa rectio eft Latinis, authoritate gravis, humanitate politus.
main_text.head: Cap. 32. De menfura.

page.notes: Small marks at the lower left margin (a faint dash and stroke) are stains, not text. Greek passages from Herodotus, Theophrastus and Josephus are transcribed from a faint scan; the Demosthenes line and the hyphenated Greek word in the Herodotus line are doubtful and marked [?].
